description: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating an accuracy/correlation comparison across five sentence-embedding model variants on three evaluation tasks (sentiment, semantic textual similarity, and paraphrase). The categorical axis is the horizontal x-axis, listing models in left-to-right order as: “Single-task_baseline,” “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout,” “Unsupervised_SimCSE,” “Supervised_SimCSE,” and “2-Tier SimCSE.” The vertical y-axis is labeled “Accuracy / Correlation” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately 0 to 0.9, with major tick labels shown at regular 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each model category contains three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: Sentiment Acc. (light beige), STS Corr. (pink), and Paraphrase Acc. (light cyan). For “Single-task_baseline,” the beige bar is about 0.53–0.54, the pink bar about 0.50, and the cyan bar about 0.80; for “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout,” the beige bar is about 0.52, the pink bar about 0.58, and the cyan bar about 0.79; for “Unsupervised_SimCSE,” the beige bar is about 0.53, the pink bar about 0.72, and the cyan bar about 0.78; for “Supervised_SimCSE,” the beige bar is about 0.49, the pink bar about 0.81, and the cyan bar about 0.78–0.79; for “2-Tier SimCSE,” the beige bar is about 0.49–0.50, the pink bar about 0.81, and the cyan bar about 0.79. The bars are not displayed as stacked and there are no visible annotations or special visual emphasis beyond the color legend.
